purpose: Remove unnecessary serialization between long-horizon prospective confirmation and bounded retrospective feasibility research while preserving prospective blindness, frozen readiness thresholds, causal timestamp integrity, and all human-decision safeguards.

problem_elimination_pass.final_user_goal: Determine whether the evidence-anchored E-event direction is worth continued prospective collection without waiting six positive calendar months before learning whether the direction has any retrospective outcome feasibility.
hard_constraints: Preserve the V2.8.12 prospective shadow information gate unchanged.
Historical or retrospective rows must never count toward the prospective information gate.
Do not alter the frozen E classifier, triage, materiality, issuer-identity, deduplication or effective-date rules in response to outcomes.
Do not inspect any historical price or return outcome until a separate retrospective sampling-and-outcome contract is frozen.
Do not access fold3 or fold4.
Do not authorize Setup, First60, Episode, live execution, brokerage execution or autonomous financial decisions.
Any retrospective result is feasibility evidence only and cannot be represented as prospective validation or a buy/sell instruction.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_constraint_removed: No outcome-oriented research of any kind may begin until the six-positive-calendar-month prospective gate is satisfied.
problem_elimination_pass.replacement: Run two causally isolated lanes in parallel: a blind prospective confirmatory lane and a bounded retrospective feasibility lane. The retrospective lane may answer whether continued prospective waiting is research-efficient, but it has zero authority to satisfy, weaken, bypass or rewrite the prospective gate.

lane_A_prospective_confirmatory.role: Prospective confirmatory evidence and eventual authorization boundary for a separately frozen prospective outcome-observation study.

lane_B_retrospective_feasibility.role: Estimate whether the frozen E-event direction has sufficient retrospective outcome signal or useful structure to justify continued prospective accumulation and future confirmatory research.
allowed_before_contract_freeze: Draft and freeze a retrospective sampling contract.
Draft and freeze an outcome definition, benchmark, horizons, missing-data handling, multiplicity policy and interpretation limits.
Define a one-time bounded historical expansion budget that is calendar/rule based and fixed before outcome inspection.
Define deterministic inclusion/exclusion rules using the already-frozen E-event semantics.
forbidden_before_contract_freeze: Inspect D1/D5/D10/D20 or any other post-event return.
Inspect win rate, IC, p-values, Sharpe-like metrics or outcome-ranked event subtypes.
Choose historical windows, issuers, keywords or E-event subtypes because their returns look favorable.
Use outcome information to relax or tighten the E classifier.

supersedes_only: The blanket interpretation that all outcome-oriented research must wait for the V2.8.12 six-month prospective readiness gate.
The blanket prohibition on drafting any outcome contract before prospective readiness, but only for the isolated retrospective feasibility lane.
does_not_supersede: The prohibition on counting V2.8.11 or other historical rows toward prospective readiness.
The prohibition on modifying classifier/triage/materiality/identity rules to rescue yield or outcomes.
The prohibition on live, brokerage or autonomous financial execution.
The prohibition on representing E events as alpha claims or buy instructions without separate validation.

next_required_action: Freeze V2.8.12R retrospective feasibility sampling-and-outcome contract before any historical price or return data are inspected. The contract must precommit the historical sampling budget/windows, event inclusion rules, outcome horizons, benchmark, missing-data policy, concentration/diversity requirements, multiplicity handling, stopping rule and interpretation ceiling.
